content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents and read_document to locate and read candidate_specs.md and any simulation/design notes relevant to absorber material options, dose-rate constraints, and allowed plate thicknesses."},{"id":"s2","description":"From candidate_specs.md, identify the three allowed absorber materials and extract their residual dose rates at 1 m after one week of cooldown. Exclude any material with dose rate >20 uSv/h, and record the numeric dose rates for the allowed materials using record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each dose-compliant material, run simulate_resolution at representative plate thicknesses across the allowed 2–10 mm range, including 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record each numeric energy resolution result."},{"id":"s4","description":"For the material and thickness region with the best preliminary resolution, run additional simulate_resolution scans at finer thickness intervals near the minimum, staying within 2–10 mm. Record all numeric resolution results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all simulated 100 GeV energy resolutions among dose-compliant candidates and identify the single material and plate thickness with the lowest resolution that satisfies all constraints. Provide this selected option and the supporting numeric results for the reporting module."}]}
